articles.summary: Kodiak has been awarded a contract by the U.S. Marine Corps to integrate the Kodiak Driver into the ROGUE-Fires platform, applying its Physical AI autonomous system to complex, unstructured military environments.
articles.title: U.S. Marine Corps Awards Kodiak AI Autonomous Ground Vehicle Development Contract

articles.title: America needs autonomous trucks. Here's why.
